reconstruction.claim_under_review: Whether TCD-025 can remain a Tier-A accounting-only admission-readiness claim for all public balance layer intervals after TCD-031 restart-state admission.
reconstruction.whole_profile_result: The pinned evidence supports a structurally determinate whole-profile macropore-plus-matrix conservation identity using domain-total storage and genuine external macropore transfers.

reconstruction.observer_guard: A missing boundary term may not be defined from the residual itself because that would make the observer self-closing rather than independently test conservation.

counter_hypothesis.alternative: Retain Tier A by deriving selected-profile solute storage and interior transfer from layer-resolved macropore water state combined with the saturated-domain mixed concentration.
counter_hypothesis.test: Check whether the frozen source-bound evidence already pins an exact species-mass owner and time/sign convention for every interior selected-profile boundary, rather than merely providing ingredients from which an observer-specific term could be invented.
counter_hypothesis.reason: Layer-resolved water storage plus a domain-level concentration does not by itself establish the exact transported species mass, concentration timing, sign convention and ownership at every arbitrary interior balance boundary. Treating that reconstruction as authoritative would add scientific control-volume semantics not yet qualified.

scope_narrowing_check.reason: The current TCD-025 readiness surface addresses the public balance mechanism whose supported intervals are configurable. A whole-profile-only claim would be a materially narrower scientific contract and must be qualified explicitly rather than silently substituted during review.
